title: Skew dropped in FLA import decompose() and compile.ts PlaceObject2
description: flash8-import.ts decompose() extracts only scale/rotation from affine matrix and discards independent skewX/skewY. Fix: compute skewX=atan2(m.c,m.d) and skewY=atan2(m.b,m.a) separately. Then wire skewX/skewY through compile.ts PlaceObject2 transform (MATRIX encoder already supports skew via the rotateSkew fields).
